extracted.name: Banana Juice
extracted.description: Blend bananas, pistachios, milk, and honey to make this banana juice recipe, which is frothy. If you like, top it with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
instruction_lines: Combine milk, bananas, pistachios, and honey in a blender; blend until smooth and frothy, about 2 minutes.
